text: Sarai Kharbuza Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Sarai Kharbuza Type: Monument - Sarai Province: Islamabad District: Islamabad Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1526 - 1857 CE Description: A Sarai, square in plan with two arched gateways provided in the northern and southern walls of the complex. The Sarai has a series of living cells with a veranda in front along the parameter wall. The Sarai has been constructed in small bricks masonry and plastered in lime surkhi. The mosque, built in the north-western corner of the Sarai is completely repaired and plastered with cement mortar. The interior of the mosque is painted with fresco paintings, the remains of the baoli of Suri period, now covered by a mosque of this Sarai has also been reported.
